name: Geo pulse globe
looks: A dotted wireframe globe sits low in the frame, lit from within by a warm glow, a thin vertical beam pinned to one point like a location marker. Above it a huge number rolls up live, counting a real-time total as if the globe is the source of the count.
build: The globe is a sphere of seeded dot points lit by a radial gradient. The beam is a thin vertical gradient line pinned to one dot's screen position, pulsing in opacity on a slow sine. The number uses data-infographic's blurred digit roll-up, its last digits still ticking as the shot ends.
sound: A low, warm drone under the globe, a soft tick as the beam pulses, and a rising tone under the counting number.
prompt: Claim global reach or real-time scale with a glowing dotted globe, a thin beam marking one specific location on it, and a huge number rolling up above as if counting live from the globe itself, the last digits still ticking as the shot ends.
source: a dub.co launch promo shared by @steventey (x.com/steventey/status/2103625902211088880), studied 2026-10-09
